text:
Looking back on this, the 3080 12GB pretty much is a cut-down 3080Ti

-Same 384 bit bus
-Same 12GB G6X rated for 19Gbps (900+GB/s of Bandwidth)
-GA012 Based die that is bigger than the 3080

So pretty much the 3080-12GB is a 3080Ti with 12% of it's CUDA Cores cut out (10SM Reduction)

Which looking at performance comparisons between the 3080-12GB, 3080 10GB, and the 3080Ti, pretty much shows that a lot of the performance increase in 3080Ti comes from that memory bus and bandwidth increase over 3080 with the 3080-12GB pretty much falling right between the two on most averages (Games that are Core depending skewing towards the 3080-10GB, games that are memory dependant skewing towards the 3080Ti)

So oddly enough, the 3080-12GB pretty much is the 3080 Super and likely would've been marketed as such if the Scalpocalype didn't happen (Very marginal increase over the 3080, like the 2080 Super is very marginal over the 2080, both to make sure the card doesn't fully overtake the next-tier up which wouldn't get a Super SKU)

Heck, like the RTX 2060 and 2070 Super, the 3080-12GB is a overclock away from hitting 3080Ti level performance 

The 3080-12GB is rated for 30TFLOPs at base spec, but overclock it to 1.9Ghz (suprisingly attainable and it may just do it on it's own with GPU boost), and it matches the 3080Ti's  rated 34TFLOPs to a T. 

Just like how overclocking the 2060 Super can let it match 2070 perfomrance and the same for the 2070 Super being a overclock away from 2080 performance.
